concepts.def: Electron jump between split d orbitals.
Absorbs visible light; complementary colour seen.
Unpaired e- attracted to magnetic field.
TMs offer multiple ox states for catalysis.

walkthroughs.body_html:
A d-block element with at least one stable ion having a partially filled d-subshell.

Sc^3+ ([Ar]) and Zn^2+ ([Ar]3d10) are NOT transition metals despite being in d-block, because their ions are d0 or d10.

Ligands split d-orbitals into two energy sets. Electron promotion absorbs visible photons; complementary colour transmitted.

Different ligands cause different splitting (spectrochemical series): CN- > NH3 > H2O > OH- > Cl-.

Heterogeneous: Fe in Haber, V2O5 in contact, Pt/Pd/Rh in catalytic converters. Adsorb reactants on surface.

Homogeneous: Fe^2+/Fe^3+ in S2O8^2- + 2I- -> 2SO4^2- + I2. Variable ox states enable e- transfer cycle.
